questions.question: What is the name of the recently launched autobiography of Nobel Peace Laureate Kailash Satyarthi?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Diyaslai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A special discussion on Nobel Laureate Kailash Satyarthi’s autobiography *Diyaslai* was held at the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Diyaslai* is an autobiography by Kailash Satyarthi that chronicles his fight against child exploitation and his journey to winning the Nobel Peace Prize.**
 
• Former President Ram Nath Kovind described *Diyaslai* as more than just a book, but a movement for child rights.
 
• Satyarthi, the son of a police constable from Vidisha, dedicated his life to advocating for child we**l**fare and education.
 
• He chose to dedicate his Nobel Prize to the nation, emphasizing his commitment to India’s future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kailash Satyarthi**__

 __
 
• Born: January 11, 1954, in Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh
 
• A social activist known for his work in child labor eradication
 
• Founder of *Bachpan Bachao Andolan*, which has rescued thousands of child laborers
 
• Received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2014, jointly with Malala Yousafzai
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)**__
 
 
• Founded in 1987 to promote Indian art and culture
 
• Located in New Delhi
 
• Hosts discussions, exhibitions, and research initiatives

questions.question: Who released the book titled 'Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh: Through the Ages' on 2nd January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• On **2nd January 2025**, **Union Minister for Home Affairs and Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah** will preside over the release of the book **‘Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh: Through the Ages’** in New Delhi, with **Union Minister for Education, Shri Dharmendra Pradhan** as the **Guest of Honour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Book Overview**: The book **‘Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh: Through the Ages’** provides a comprehensive history of the regions, spanning over **three thousand years**. It presents the story of **Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh** from an accessible perspective, catering to both experts and general readers.
 
• The book was authored by the **Indian Council of Historical Research (ICHR), with Prof. Raghuvendra Tanwar serving as its editor.**
 
• **Structure**: The book is divided into **seven sections**, each illustrating key periods and historical contributions of the regions. The **illustrations** included are carefully selected to represent significant ages and their relevance in the larger historical context of **Indian history**.
 
• **Collaborative Effort**: The book is a collaborative publication by **National Book Trust, India** and the **Indian Council of Historical Research**, and is available in both **Hindi and English**.

questions.question: What is the title of Banu Mushtaq’s short story collection that has been shortlisted for the International Booker Prize 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Heart Lamp**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ‘Heart Lamp’ becomes 1st Kannada title shortlisted for International Booker Prize 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Banu Mushtaq’s short story collection**, **‘Heart Lamp’**, has been shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection has been **translated from Kannada to English** by **Deepa Bhasthi**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time a Kannada title** has been shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection consists of **12 stories**, originally published between **1990 and 2023**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mushtaq’s work** is praised for its **witty, vivid, colloquial, moving, and excoriating style** in capturing portraits of **family and community tensions**.

 
 
• 
 
The collection is one of **six titles** shortlisted for the **International Booker Prize 2025**.

questions.question: Who is the author of the autobiography On That Note: Memories of a Life in Music?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Subrahmanyan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **"On That Note"** is the autobiography of Carnatic vocalist **Sanjay Subrahmanyan**, co-authored by **Krupa Ge**, providing insights into his life and artistic journey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The book explores his evolution from a **reluctant learner to an accomplished artiste**, highlighting the influence of family, mentors, and the socio-cultural milieu of his upbringing in **Mylapore**.
 
• Sanjay reflects on his **post-pandemic career changes**, considering it an apt time to chronicle his five-decade journey in Carnatic music.
 
• The book balances a **concise narrative with rich details**, covering his **growing-up years**, ongoing learning, insecurities, and innovative approaches to his craft.

questions.question: Who is the author of the book '2024: The Election that Surprised India'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajdeep Sardesai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajdeep Sardesai is a renowned Indian news anchor and author.
 
• The book "2024: The Election that Surprised India" is his analysis of the 2024 Indian general elections.
 
• He has previously authored books like "2014: The Election that Changed India" and "Newsman: Tracking India in the Modi Era".
 
• Rajdeep Sardesai is known for his in-depth political analysis and journalistic expertise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Book Overview**

 
 
• The book provides a comprehensive analysis of the political climate leading up to and during the 2024 elections in India.
 
• It explores the key players, strategies, and unexpected outcomes that defined the election.
 
 
 
• **Rajdeep Sardesai's Career**
 
 
• He has worked with leading news channels like NDTV, CNN-IBN, and India Today.
 
• He is a recipient of numerous awards, including the Padma Shri in 2008.
 
 
 
• **Context of the 2024 Elections**
 
 
• The 2024 Indian general elections are a pivotal moment in Indian politics, shaping the future of governance and policy.
 
• The book delves into the social, economic, and political factors influencing voter behavior.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Book**
 
 
• The book aims to provide readers with a deeper understanding of the complexities of Indian politics.
 
• It is a valuable resource for scholars, political enthusiasts, and anyone interested in contemporary Indian history.

questions.question: The National Archives of India launched the "Ramanujan: Journey of a Great Mathematician" book. Who are the authors of the book?

options.text: Dr. Ramesh Sharma and S. Natarajan
Arun Singhal and Dr. Devendra Kumar Sharma
Dr. Manjul Bhargava and K. Radhakrishnan
V. Balaji and T. S. Mahadevan

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Arun Singhal and Dr. Devendra Kumar Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• National Archives of India launches book ‘Ramanujan: Journey of a Great Mathematician’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **National Archives of India** launched a book titled **‘Ramanujan: Journey of a Great Mathematician’**.

 
 
• 
 
The launch took place in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The book covers the **life and mathematical contributions** of **Srinivasa Ramanujan**.

 
 
• 
 
Ramanujan was born in **Erode, Tamil Nadu**.

 
 
• 
 
His work included **number theory, infinite series, and continued fractions**.

The book emphasizes Ramanujan's lasting impact on **modern mathematics**.

The authors are **Arun Singhal** and **Dr. Devendra Kumar Sharma**.

questions.question: Name the book released at the Indian Navy Chiefs' Conclave 2025 held at Naval Headquarters, New Delhi.

options.text: Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Book "Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time" was released at the Indian Navy Chiefs' Conclave 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The book chronicles the inspiring journeys of former Indian Navy Chiefs (CNSs).
 
• It offers personal stories, rare photographs, and firsthand accounts from the leadership of past Naval Chiefs.
 
• The book was launched on the sidelines of the Indian Navy Chiefs’ Conclave 2025.
 
• It provides unique insights into the leadership of the former CNSs, contributing to the institutional continuity of the Indian Navy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Navy Chiefs’ Conclave__

 __

• Discussions focused on technological advancements, operational updates, and maritime strategy for future leadership.
 
 
 
• Legacy of Leadership__
 
 
• The book reflects on the leadership and contributions of past Navy Chiefs, enhancing the understanding of India's maritime history.
 
• It underscores the commitment of the Indian Navy to carry forward its legacy while adapting to modern geopolitical and strategic challenges.
